entries.definition: a piece of work given to a student
entries.example: Our assignment asks us to interview a neighbor.

entries.definition: the latest time when work must be finished
entries.example: The deadline for the essay is next Monday.

entries.definition: to be present at an event or class
entries.example: I attend an evening class twice a week.

entries.definition: not present where someone is expected
entries.example: Two students were absent because of the storm.

entries.definition: being at a particular place or event
entries.example: Everyone must be present for the safety lesson.

entries.definition: to study something again to understand it better
entries.example: We review yesterday’s vocabulary before learning new words.

entries.definition: to get ready for something
entries.example: I prepare questions before each conversation class.

entries.definition: repeated activity that develops a skill
entries.example: A little daily practice helps me speak more easily.

entries.definition: movement toward a better or more developed state
entries.example: The teacher noticed real progress in my writing.

entries.definition: to become better or make something better
entries.example: Reading aloud can improve your confidence in speaking.

entries.definition: an ability developed through learning and practice
entries.example: Listening carefully is an important skill in teamwork.

entries.definition: an area of knowledge studied at school
entries.example: History became my favorite subject last year.

entries.definition: a series of lessons on a particular topic
entries.example: This course includes short lessons and practical tasks.

entries.definition: a talk given to teach a group
entries.example: The lecture ended with questions from the students.

entries.definition: a small class where people discuss a topic
entries.example: In our seminar, everyone shares one reading question.

entries.definition: a practical class where people develop a skill
entries.example: The writing workshop helped us organize our ideas.

entries.definition: a teacher who helps one learner or a small group
entries.example: My tutor asked me to explain each answer.

entries.definition: a person you work with on an activity
entries.example: My partner checked the spelling while I checked dates.

entries.definition: careful study done to discover information
entries.example: Our research began with a visit to the library.

entries.definition: a planned piece of work with a particular aim
entries.example: The class project explored ways to reduce paper waste.

entries.definition: a test used to learn how something works
entries.example: We designed an experiment with two kinds of soil.

entries.definition: information telling someone how to do something
entries.example: Read each instruction before connecting the equipment.

entries.definition: a section of writing that develops one main idea
entries.example: The first paragraph introduces the problem clearly.

entries.definition: a short account of the main points
entries.example: Her summary explains the article without extra details.

entries.definition: a structured piece of writing about a subject
entries.example: My essay compares two ways to learn vocabulary.

entries.definition: an early version of a piece of writing
entries.example: I changed the ending after reading my first draft.

entries.definition: comments intended to help someone improve
entries.example: The teacher’s feedback focused on clear sentence links.

entries.definition: something done or understood incorrectly
entries.example: I wrote the wrong date by mistake.

entries.definition: to change something so that it is right
entries.example: Please correct the address before printing the form.

entries.definition: able to speak a language easily and smoothly
entries.example: She is fluent in English but still checks technical words.

entries.definition: correct and without important mistakes
entries.example: An accurate map should show the new bridge.

entries.definition: believing that you can do something successfully
entries.example: I feel more confident after practicing with a friend.

entries.definition: able to work or act without much help
entries.example: The course encourages independent study between meetings.

entries.definition: to learn something so that you can remember it exactly
entries.example: I do not memorize a speech before every conversation.

entries.definition: to identify something you have encountered before
entries.example: I recognize this word when I hear it in a story.

entries.definition: to give your full attention to something
entries.example: I concentrate better when I silence my phone.

entries.definition: to know the meaning or reason for something
entries.example: I understand the rule better after seeing an example.

entries.definition: to find an answer to a problem
entries.example: Our group tried to solve the problem in two ways.

entries.definition: a particular way of doing something
entries.example: This method helps me remember useful word combinations.

entries.definition: something that shows what a rule or idea means
entries.example: The example explains how to make a polite request.

entries.definition: information that supports an idea or conclusion
entries.example: We need evidence before accepting the surprising claim.

entries.definition: a place or person from which information comes
entries.example: Write down the source of every quotation you use.

entries.definition: to examine similarities and differences
entries.example: We compare our answers before the class discussion.

entries.definition: to say what someone or something is like
entries.example: Can you describe the shape without showing the picture?

entries.definition: to talk about a subject and exchange ideas
entries.example: We discuss the ending after everyone finishes the story.

entries.definition: to succeed in reaching an aim
entries.example: Small weekly goals help us achieve a larger aim.

entries.definition: the capacity to do something
entries.example: Her ability to explain difficult ideas impressed the class.

entries.definition: information and understanding gained through learning
entries.example: Sharing knowledge can help a whole team improve.

entries.definition: a document stating that someone completed or achieved something
entries.example: The course certificate records the work I completed.

entries.definition: a plan showing when activities will happen
entries.example: My study schedule leaves time for rest.
